description.value: Cafe Malabar is a Kerala cuisine restaurant in downtown Victoria, founded by chefs Kiran Kolathodan and Karma Tenpa, both raised in Southern India with over 30 years of combined experience in luxury kitchens across Canada and India. The menu centres on Malabar seafood—prawns, curries—alongside vegetarian and meat dishes layered with spices reflecting Portuguese, Dutch, and French culinary influences. A seasonal patio is available, and the restaurant takes reservations as well as take-out orders.
